title_sq: Penthouse 2+1+2 me Verande Private ne TEG
description_sq:
Apartamenti ndodhet ne nje nga rezidencat luksoze te zones se TEG, dhe ka nje siperfaqe totale prej 139.2 m2
Apartamenti ka dhe veranden e tij te aksesuar me shkalle te brendshme, ku perfshihen dhe nje Jacuzzi per 4 persona, si dhe panelet diellore.
Objekti eshte i termoizoluar me sistem kapote dhe fasade me pllaka terrakote te cilesise me te larte. Dritaret termoizoluese jane me xham triplex dhe kane shtrirje te gjatesise deri ne dysheme, perfshire grila elektrike.
Objekti ka akses te menjehershem ne rruget e shpejtesise perreth, si dhe ndodhet fare prane qendres tregtare TEG.
Prona disponon certifikate pronesie!
title_en: Penthouse 2+1+2 with Private Veranda in TEG
description_en: The apartment is located in one of the luxurious residences of the TEG area, and has a total area of ​​139.2 m2. The apartment has its own veranda accessed by an internal staircase, which includes a Jacuzzi for 4 people, as well as solar panels. The building is thermally insulated with a hood system and a facade with terracotta tiles of the highest quality. The thermally insulating windows are triplex glass and extend to the floor, including electric shutters. The facility has immediate access to the surrounding expressways, as well as being located very close to the TEG shopping center. The property has ownership certificates!
